label: Present input: the candidate is actually presented to the favouring at the scenario
definition: Present s x: at scenario s the candidate x is actually present to the favouring source as something that acts on it, as the loads on a balance's pans are. A source favouring among candidates before any of them is produced has no present inputs.
note: Stipulative analyst notion (#2145 Investigation 4), attribution deferred. Lean has no declaration for it: it is the parameter Present : S → X → Prop. It is a declared primitive; it is not existence at a world and not being caused.
